title: 2026.43: A New Era
author: Ben Thompson
description: The best Stratechery content from the week of October 19, 2026, including the best iPad but worst phone, SS Sarandos in a storm, and You Can See Everything.
summary: Welcome back to This Week in Stratechery! This week marks a new era for Stratechery, which is now presented by Stripe .
takeaways: I wanted to be a professional blogger long before I started Stratechery; however, I thought I had missed my chance, particularly as it became clear that advertising was not a long term business model for a one-person site.
However, when Stripe launched with support for recurring billing, I realized there was a better model: subscriptions.
Muse Spark Open, Meta + Apple, Thin and Thick — Meta has a new open source model, and to everyone’s surprise, they are are partnering with Apple to make sure you can run it locally.
